normalize_screen_coordinates: normalize 2D screen coordinates to [-1, 1] range while preserving aspect ratio for image width and height
project_to_2d: project 3D points in camera space to 2D using Human3.6M camera projection with radial and tangential distortion
project_to_2d_linear: project 3D points in camera space to 2D using only linear focal length and principal point parameters
world_to_camera: transform 3D points from world space to camera space using rotation quaternion and translation vector
camera_to_world: transform 3D points from camera space to world space using rotation quaternion and translation vector
